description: This file defines the RDKWindowManagerImplementation class, which implements the IRDKWindowManager interface for managing window displays, input events, and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and related data structures for window management functionalities.

classes.name: CreateDisplayRequest
classes.description: A data structure representing a request to create a display with specific parameters such as client name, display name, dimensions, and flags.

classes.name: RDKWindowManagerImplementation
classes.description: A class implementing the IRDKWindowManager interface, providing window management functionalities including display creation, input handling, and event notification within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: RdkWindowManagerListener
classes.description: A nested class within RDKWindowManagerImplementation that listens for window manager events such as user inactivity.

methods.name: RDKWindowManagerImplementation
methods.description: Constructor for the window manager implementation class.

methods.name: ~RDKWindowManagerImplementation
methods.description: Destructor for the window manager implementation class.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window manager with the provided service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the window manager, releasing resources.

methods.name: CreateDisplay
methods.description: Creates a new display with specified parameters.

methods.name: GetClients
methods.description: Retrieves the list of connected clients.

methods.name: AddKeyIntercept
methods.description: Adds a key intercept for input handling.

methods.name: GenerateKey
methods.description: Generates a key event for a client.

methods.name: GetKeyRepeatsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if key repeats are enabled.

methods.name: EnableInputEvents
methods.description: Enables or disables input events for clients.
